name: Onfasprodil
summary: Onfasprodil (MIJ821) is a drug delivered via intravenous infusion that is designed as a fast-acting treatment for treatment-resistant depression. It works as a negative allosteric modulator of the NMDA receptor subunit 2B (NR2B). The drug is developed by Novartis.

pharmacology.text: It works as a negative allosteric modulator of the NMDA receptor subunit 2B (NR2B).

uses.text: Onfasprodil (MIJ821) is a drug delivered via intravenous infusion that is designed as a fast-acting treatment for treatment-resistant depression. The drug is developed by Novartis.

fact.en: It targets only the NR2B part of the NMDA receptor, an attempt to get the rapid antidepressant effect seen with ketamine while leaving the rest of the receptor alone.
fact.zh: 它只針對 NMDA 受體的 NR2B 次單元，試圖取得氯胺酮那種快速的抗憂鬱效果，同時不影響受體的其他部分。
fact.zhHans: 它只针对 NMDA 受体的 NR2B 次单元，试图取得氯胺酮那种快速的抗忧郁效果，同时不影响受体的其他部分。
